incidents.title: Sterling auth token missing from integration response
incidents.summary: Every Sterling API call is dereferencing `access_token` on an undefined auth response, so the integration cannot authenticate and all downstream order sync fails.
incidents.rootCause: The Sterling auth endpoint is returning a non-2xx or empty body and the response is used without a guard, so `response.data` is undefined when `access_token` is read.
incidents.remediation: Guard the auth response before dereferencing, log the raw status/body on failure, and verify STERLING_API_PK plus the token endpoint URL are valid for this environment.

incidents.title: Schema drift: column `Location.Provider` missing from database
incidents.summary: Sequelize is selecting a column the database does not have, so the query aborts. The model definition is ahead of the deployed schema.
incidents.rootCause: A model attribute was added in code without a matching migration being run on this database, producing MySQL ER_BAD_FIELD_ERROR (1054).
incidents.remediation: Run the pending migrations on this environment, or gate the new attribute behind a schema check. Confirm the model and the deployed table agree before redeploying.

incidents.title: Connection timeouts reaching the Sterling API
incidents.summary: Outbound calls to the Sterling API are timing out at the TCP layer, so order tracking and scheduling stall until the connection recovers.
incidents.rootCause: Network path or upstream availability issue reaching the Sterling host on port 443 — not an application logic fault.
incidents.remediation: Add a bounded retry with backoff around the Sterling client, alert on sustained timeout rates, and confirm egress/firewall rules and upstream status.

incidents.title: Location lookup failing for unknown or null external IDs
incidents.summary: Scheduling lookups are being issued for location IDs that Sterling does not recognise, including null IDs, so those orders cannot be assigned a location.
incidents.rootCause: Orders carry stale or empty ExternalLocationId values that are passed straight to the scheduling API without validation.
incidents.remediation: Skip lookups when the external location ID is null, and reconcile the stored location IDs against Sterling's current location list.

incidents.title: Scheduling search called without coordinates or search term
incidents.summary: The Sterling scheduling search is being invoked with neither coordinates nor a search term, so the request is rejected before any locations are returned.
incidents.rootCause: The location task builds a search request from order address data that is incomplete, and issues it without checking that at least one search key is present.
incidents.remediation: Validate that latitude/longitude or a searchTerm is present before calling the scheduling service, and skip or queue the order when it is not.
